sources.used_for: List is read-only API, MutableList provides mutation operations; read-only interface does not entail immutable backing object.
toList creates a copy of collection structure (shallow copy semantics for elements).
Sequence intermediate operations are lazy; terminal operations trigger processing; collection operations differ in eagerness.
Iterable exposes iterator contract and does not itself require eager production of all elements.
Sequence.sorted is intermediate and stateful, consistent with buffering during consumption.
flatten/flatMap provide flattening behavior for nested collections; flatMap maps then flattens.
